title: tragacantha calabrica
intro: Tragacantha calabrica, commonly known as Italian thistle, is a species of plant in the aster family that is native to the Mediterranean region. It has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Tragacantha calabrica include soothing digestive issues, reducing fever, and alleviating respiratory problems, such as bronchitis and coughs. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
